u0: Initial monitoring state: the siren has not rung yet and the agent has not reached the exit. Continue navigating toward the green exit; arriving there ends the episode in u3 with the full terminal reward. If the siren starts ringing, the state changes to u1 and the agent should shift attention to the switch.
u1: Siren-response state: the siren is ringing and has not yet been handled. Navigate to the wall switch, stand on the adjacent floor cell facing it, and toggle it to silence the siren, earn the one-time 0.1 toggle reward, and move to u2. Reaching the exit now would still terminate the episode in u3, but otherwise keep pursuing the switch toggle.
u2: Post-toggle state: the agent has already toggled the switch in response to the siren, so the 0.1 switch bonus is secured. Any later siren restart leaves the agent in this state, and additional toggles give no further RM reward. The active objective is simply to reach the green exit to terminate in u3 with reward 1.
u3: Terminal state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode ends. No further subtasks or RM transitions remain, and reaching this absorbing final state awards the terminal exit reward.
